notes.title: v0.5.0 Demo Update Major Content & Balance Update
notes.content:
🆕 New ContentNew Weapon
Around Weapon - A versatile new weapon type added to your arsenal

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/ae84e47f18a1632c111398b0c9d94480877070de.png"]
New Cards
+Crystal Amount
New Mechanics
Banish System - Remove unwanted cards from your upgrade pool

Reroll System - Refresh your upgrade card options

Skip System - Pass on upgrade cards without penalty

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/a7dce123a0e4cdbc9f58e7ee79a1fe312e522636.png"]
🔧 Quality of Life ImprovementsUI/UX Enhancements
Upgrade Tooltips - Hovering over upgrades now displays detailed descriptions

Regeneration Display - Current health regeneration per second now shown in GUI

Quest Management - Completed quests are automatically removed from quest list

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/b4bdbd68ac654fae63c4aec884663541e5f6a11e.png"]
Performance & Flow
Portal Speed - Portal appearance and disappearance animations are now 2x faster

Early Game Pacing - Enemies now spawn faster at the beginning of runs

Collision Improvements - Increased collision detection for boxes and pots for better interaction
✨ New Shrine System
Risk/Reward Shrines - Trade-off shrines that take x2 of one stat while giving x2 of another

Example: Halve player movement speed while doubling attack speed

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/aef84a90829e8c0a1d4566390159871a176b8c95.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/258b7cf6dfb9bd9afe309137ae89082cdb9eeacd.png"]
💰 Economy Rebalancing
Shop Prices - All shop items reduced by 50%

Skill Tree Costs - All skill tree upgrades reduced
🐛 Bug Fixes
Mini-boss Chest - Fixed issue where mini-bosses weren't spawning treasure chests

Dodge Cap - Fixed 100% dodge exploit; maximum dodge chance now capped at 50%

Level Cap - Resolved issue where maximum level could exceed 100

Experience Card - Corrected overpowered +100% Experience card, now provides +50%

Explosion Radius - Reduced initial explosion radius by 50% for better balance
[hr][/hr]
This update focuses on expanding player choice while improving game balance and addressing community feedback. Enjoy the new content and enhanced gameplay experience!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.0
notes.content:
New Features

New Enemy: Added Skeleton as a new regular enemy type
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/a7fd51ffeccbbcc5a9e810180c6db5d94ebd02d0.png"]
New Weapon: Introduced Area Weapon to the arsenal
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/8e4d70372d12531332d6e4a9791e3458ff34f9bb.png"]

Level Cap: Implemented level limit of 100 levels maximum

Distance Indicators: Added distance text display for shrines

Boss Combat: New Reaper boss now features circle area attack ability

Health System: Added health regeneration card upgrade option

Visual Effects: Updated explosion effects for rocket launcher

Interactive Elements: Chests now launch rockets when opened

Leaderboard System:

Added automatic reset timer for leaderboards

Added reload functionality for leaderboard list

UI Improvements:

Added damage popup notifications when player takes damage

Improved text sizing for high score displays

Level Design: Shrines are now placed at level start
Bug Fixes
Weapons: Fixed Assault Rifle muzzle flash emission intensity and light intensity

UI Elements: Corrected indicator distance text positioning

Biome Balance: Adjusted white biome pacing for better gameplay flow

Enemy Drops: Changed Chafer XP drop to rare tier

Boss Mechanics:

Fixed boss landing position accuracy

Corrected boss camera look behavior

Fixed boss spawn positioning issues

Camera Settings: Adjusted game camera FOV from 75 to 60 and increased camera distance from 20 to 30

Difficulty System: Resolved issue where difficulty multiplier remained at 2 when player entered portal

Spawn Mechanics: Fixed level pacing spawn rate calculations
